detailed_descriptions.en: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check Supporter Pack delivers a bonus fan package with extra cosmetics for players who want to support the developer beyond buying the game itself. The package includes a new command room interior, as well as new skins for three of the most crucial tools you'll use while protecting your base from the outbreak. Important note: Everything in this pack is purely cosmetic. No gameplay advantages, no hidden boosts, just some extra flair. If you pick it up, you're doing it to look cool and to directly support the developers making Quarantine Zone.
